sector_model: Clinical stage biotech with a licensed lead asset: cash, burn and runway, milestone and royalty economics, and dilution govern value; free cash flow multiples and the screen's 2025 margins are not meaningful because FY2025 revenue was a one-time Takeda upfront and milestone windfall.
thesis: Keros Therapeutics (Nasdaq: KROS) came out of the annual screen with 244M of 2025 revenue and a 36% margin, but that was Takeda license revenue (9M25 license revenue 205.4M, total 243.7M, net income 110.5M); it is not recurring. Q3 2026 10-Q (read in part, first 200,000 of about 244,600 characters): 9M26 revenue 40.4M (40.0M of Takeda development milestones for first dosing in the ELRiSE MDS and MF Phase 3 trials), 9M26 net loss 38.3M, operating cash flow -20.6M, capex 0.3M; cash and equivalents 259.5M, no debt, total liabilities 28.3M (lease liabilities 15.1M), equity 279.1M. A further 20.0M milestone was received in November 2026 per the 8-K of 2026-11-16. R&D 58.9M and G&A 25.5M for 9M26 (Q3 20.5M and 6.7M), so run-rate operating spending is about 27M per quarter; management says cash funds operations into the second half of 2028 (8-K says into 2029 including the 20M milestone). Price: close 11.31 on 2026-11-17 (up 12.8% from 10.03 on 11-16; cause not identified) x 19,624,374 shares (10-30 cover) = 222.0M market cap, below 259.5M cash (13.22 per share) and below roughly 279.5M cash after the 20M milestone (14.24 per share, derived, before November burn). Enterprise value on cash alone is about negative 37.5M, so the market assigns little or negative value to elritercept royalties (low double digits to high teens), up to 40M more development, 280M commercial and 740M sales milestones, and to rinvatercept (KER-065) Phase 2 DMD data expected 1H 2027. Management plans to distribute 25% of net Takeda cash proceeds received through 2028 and runs a 5M buyback (1.7M done at 11.27 average). This is a net cash discount, not a proven bargain: cash burns about 100M a year at current spending, so the cash 'floor' erodes, and value depends on Takeda continuing to fund Phase 3.
counterthesis: Cash is not owned free and clear: about 109M of annualized operating spend means roughly 2.5 years of runway, and the ATM (about 100M available) signals dilution risk if the stock rises or trials need funding. Takeda can terminate for convenience or on safety, leaving no further milestones; open-label Phase 2 elritercept data may overstate effects; the price may be low because the market expects Phase 3 failure, a cheaper or competing MDS anemia therapy, or because the earlier cibotercept program was stopped. Insider Form 144 filings on 11-12 and 11-17 and a Form 4 on 11-16 were seen in the filing list but not read. The 11-17 rise of 12.8% was not explained. Screen figures (2025 margin, score 97.8) are windfall driven and must not be read as quality.
invalidation: The net cash discount thesis fails if Takeda terminates or pauses the elritercept Phase 3 program, if safety signals appear, if cash falls well below 200M without milestones, if the company issues stock below cash value through the ATM, or if the price rises above cash plus a modest pipeline value so no discount remains.
